description: This file contains implementation of bit encoding and decoding classes, including methods for packing and unpacking bits and bytes, as well as managing bit and byte alignment.

classes.name: bit_encoder
classes.description: Class for encoding bits and bytes into a buffer.

classes.name: bit_decoder
classes.description: Class for decoding bits and bytes from a buffer.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Encodes a value into the buffer using a specified number of bits.

methods.name: pack_bytes
methods.description: Encodes a span or buffer of bytes into the buffer, handling alignment.

methods.name: advance_bits
methods.description: Advances the read position by a specified number of bits.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Decodes a value from the buffer, extracting a specified number of bits.

methods.name: unpack_bytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from the buffer into a span, handling alignment.

methods.name: unpack_aligned_bytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of aligned bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: align_bytes
methods.description: Aligns the buffer to the next byte boundary.
